eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: ブレーキペダルを突然強く踏まず、圧力を徐々に増やしながら制動する方法。急ブレーキによる体の衝撃や車体の前へのつり，减少を抑える。
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: ブレーキを一度に強く踏まず、圧力を少しずつ増やして止めること。

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: 제동 페달을 한 번에 세게 밟지 않고 압력을 steadily 높여 차체를 부드럽게 멈추는 방식. 급제동이나 승차감 감소에 도움이 된다.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: 한 번에 세게 밟지 않고 페달 압력을 점차 높이는 제동 방식.

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: Aplicação progressiva do freio,increasing a pressão aos poucos para deixar a parada mais suave. Ela ajuda a evitar travamento das rodas e improve o controle do veículo.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: Frenagem feita com aumento gradual da pressão no pedal, em vez de uma aplicação súbita.

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: Cara pengereman dengan menambah tekanan pedal rem secara bertahap secara terus-menerus. Cara ini membuat kendaraan berhenti lebih halus.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: Pengereman dengan tekanan yang terus meningkat, bukan sekali tekan mendadak.

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: วิธีเพิ่มแรงเบรกอย่างต่อเนื่องเพื่อให้รถหยุดได้อย่างนุ่มนวล แทนการกดเบรกแรงทันทีซึ่งอาจทำให้รถไถลหรือล้อล็อก
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: การเหยียบเบรกด้วยแรงที่ค่อยเป็นค่อยไปแทนการกดรวดเดียว

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.definition: Fren pedalına basıncın aşamalı olarak artırılmasıdır. Ani ve sert bir frenleme yerine daha yumuşak bir duruş sağlar.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.gloss: Fren pedalına bir anda bastırmak yerine basıncı kademeli artırmak.

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.translation: Yoğun trafikte kademeli frenledi ve araç yumuşak biçimde durdu.
ในการจราจรหนาแน่น เธอใช้การเหยียบเบรกแบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ทำให้รถหยุดได้อย่างนุ่มนวล
Dalam lalu lintas padat, ia menggunakan pengereman progresif sehingga berhenti dengan halus.
No trânsito intenso, ela usou frenagem progressiva e a parada foi suave.
교통이 혼잡할 때 점진 제동을 사용하여 매끄럽게 멈췄다.
渋滞中は渐进的なブレーキを使い、isser stoppingが滑らかになった。

eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.text: In heavy traffic she used progressive braking and the stop was smooth.
eb01d3c44a58df46fe14cbb8cee40a29e2c853b2.translation: Trong giao thông đông đúc, cô ấy dùng phanh tiến dần và xe dừng mượt mà.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: The whole arrangement that connects the metal parts of an installation to the earth, so that a fault current has a safe way back.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: The whole arrangement that connects the metal parts of an installation to the earth, so that a fault current has a safe way back.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: 設備の金属部分を大地に接続し、漏れた電流を安全な経路へ戻す装置や配線の全体です。简单地アースという場合只能用 Recall — no!
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: 設備初代を大地につなぎ、異常電流を安全に戻す仕組み。

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: 전기 시설의 금속 부분을 접지에 연결하여 고장 전류가 안전한 경로로 흘러가게 하는 장치와 배선. 단순히 earth로 연결된 선 하나를 뜻하지 않는다.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: 시설의 금속 부품을 접지에 연결해 고장 전류가 안전하게 흐르게 하는 전체 배치.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: Conjunto de conexões que liga as partes metálicas de uma instalação elétrica à terra, oferecendo um caminho seguro para correntes de falha. É essencial para a proteção contra choques e danos aos equipamentos.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: Ligação das partes metálicas de uma instalação com a terra para descarga segura de correntes de falha.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: Susunan pengh Ministerial ke tanah yang menghubungkan bagian logam instalasi dan menyediakan jalur aman bagi arus kesalah. Kata ini mencakup seluruh sistem pentanahan, bukan hanya kabelnya.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: Susunan pengh Ministerial ke tanah yang menghubungkan bagian logam instalasi dan menyediakan jalur aman bagi arus kesalah.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: การเชื่อมต่อส่วนโลหะของอุปกรณ์หรือการติดตั้งเข้ากับดิน เช่น ดินหรือหลักประสงค์ เพื่อให้กระแสไฟรั่วมีทางไหลกลับลงดินอย่างปลอดภัยเมื่อเกิดความผิดพลาด คำนี้หมายถึงทั้งระบบที่ต่อลงดินและตัวสายหรือแผ่นที่ทำหน้าที่ต่อลงดิน
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: การต่อสายดินของส่วนโลหะในระบบไฟฟ้า เพื่อให้กระแสรั่วมีทางระบายลงดินอย่างปลอดภัย

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.definition: Bir tesisatın metal bölümlerini toprağa bağlayan ve hata akımının güvenli biçimde toprağa aktarılmasını sağlayan düzenektir. Topraklama ile topraklama aynı anlama gelir.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.gloss: Tesisatın metal bölümlerini toprağa bağlayarak hata akımının güvenli bir yol bulmasını sağlayan düzenektir.

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.translation: Panon değiştirildiğinde pompanın topraklaması kontrol edildi.
เมื่อเปลี่ยนแผงวงจร มีการตรวจสอบการต่อสายดินของปั๊ม
Pentanahan pompa diperiksa ketika papan listrik diganti.
O aterramento da bomba foi verificado quando o quadro elétrico foi substituído.
보드를 교체할 때 펌프의 접지 상태를 확인했다.
盤を交換したとき、ポンプの接地が点検された。

eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.text: The earthing of the pump was checked when the board was replaced.
eb1164a3920e467249f557a4bfcd03c4b097ed94.translation: Hệ thống nối đất của bơm đã được kiểm tra khi bảng điện được thay thế.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: The checkpoint where bags and people are checked before entering the secure part of the airport.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: The checkpoint where bags and people are checked before entering the secure part of the airport.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: 空港の制御区域へ入る前の検査Fiscal point であり、荷物と人が確認される。
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: 空港の/security 区域に入る前に荷物と人が検査される場所。

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: 공항 보안 구역에 들어가기 전에 승객과 짐을 검사하는 보안 관문이다.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: 공항의 보안 구역에 들어가기 전 사람과 짐을 검사하는 곳.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: É o procedimento realizado em um ponto de controle, geralmente após a apresentação do documento de embarque. Abrange a inspeção de passageiros e malas.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: Verificação de pessoas e bagagens antes da entrada em uma área restrita do aeroporto.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: Di pemeriksaan keamanan, petugas memeriksa orang dantas sebelum penumpang boleh memasuki bagian Revisial yang dikendalikan ketat.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: Tempat pemeriksaan orang dan barang sebelum memasuki bagian aman bandara.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: จุดตรวจสอบกระเป๋าและผู้โดยสารก่อนเข้าสู่พื้นที่ควบคุมของสนามบิน โดยทั่วไปจะตรวจทั้งสัมภาระถือและกระเป๋าเดินทาง
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: จุดตรวจความปลอดภัยก่อนเข้าสู่ส่วนควบคุมของสนามบิน

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.definition: Havalimanının güvenli bölümüne girmeden önce insanların ve eşyaların kontrol edildiği nokta.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.gloss: Havalimanının güvenli bölümüne girmeden önce insanların ve eşyaların kontrol edildiği nokta.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: Güvenlik kontrolü bu koridorun sonunda başlıyor.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: การตรวจความปลอดภัยเริ่มต้นที่ปลายทางเดินทางนี้

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: Pemeriksaan keamanan dimulai di ujung koridor ini.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: A inspeção de segurança começa no fim deste corredor.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: 이 복도 끝에서 보안 검사가 시작됩니다.

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.
eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.translation: この廊下の先から保安検査が始まります。

eb165c72223117412c644e6cb7e84018e80dc9af.text: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: The roughly 24-hour cycle that sets your sleep, hormones, body temperature and appetite. Light is its strongest input.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: The roughly 24-hour cycle that sets your sleep, hormones, body temperature and appetite. Light is its strongest input.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: 睡眠、ホルモン、体温、食欲などの rhythm? を調整する約二十四時間の周期で、光が主に調整の手掛かりになる。
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: 睡眠や体内時計に関わる約二十四時間の周期。

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: 수면, 호르몬 분비, 체온, 식욕 등을 약 24시간 주기로 조절하는 몸의 rhythms입니다. 빛이 이 주기에 가장 큰 영향을 줍니다.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: 수면과 호르몬 등을 조절하는 약 24시간 주기의 생체리듬.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: Ciclo biológico de aproximadamente 24 horas que regula o sono, a secreção de hormônios, a temperatura corporal e o apetite. A luz é o principal fator que o ajusta.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: Ciclo de cerca de 24 horas que regula o sono, os hormônios, a temperatura do corpo e o apetite.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: Ritme internal yang mengatur pola tidur, hormon, suhu tubuh, dan食欲 dalam siklus sekitar 24 jam. Cahaya merupakan faktor utama yang memengaruhi ritme tersebut.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: Siklus alami sekitar 24 jam yang mengatur tidur dan berbagai fungsi tubuh.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: วงจรชีวภาพความยาวประมาณ 24 ชั่วโมงที่ควบคุมการนอน ฮอร์โมน อุณหภูมิร่างกาย และความหิว โดยแสงเป็นปัจจัยสำคัญที่สุดในการกำหนดจังหวะนี้
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: จังหวะชีวภาพรายวันที่ควบคุมการนอนและการทำงานของร่างกาย

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.definition: İç saat dediğimiz biyolojik döngü; en güçlü etkileyicisi ışıktır. Gece vardiyası gibi alışkanlıklar bu ritmin kaymasına yol açabilir.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.gloss: Uyku, hormonal düzen, vücut sıcaklığı ve açlık gibi süreçleri yaklaşık 24 saatlik bir döngüyle düzenleyen biyolojik ritim.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: Her gece saat ikiye kadar uyuduğum için sirkadiyen ritmim kaymış görünüyor.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: จังหวะชีวภาพรายวันของฉันเลื่อนไป เพราะฉันเข้านอนตอนสองทุกคืน

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: Ritme sirkadian saya bergeser karena selama ini saya selalu tidur pada pukul dua pagi.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: Meu ritmo circadiano mudou, porque tenho ido dormir às duas da manhã todos os dias.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: 매일 새벽 2시에 잠들면서 제 일중 리듬이 바뀌었습니다.

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.
eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.translation: 毎日二時に寝ているため、私の体内時計がずれている。

eb304623fea5245e92b2c46797f8cad7f123e1fc.text: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: A line that is not crossed at all, such as asking about somebody's salary.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: A line that is not crossed at all, such as asking about somebody's salary.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: ある話題や行為について、話したり行ったりしてはならない被视为禁則となる社会的な決まり。法律による禁止とは限らない。
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: 誰かの給料を尋ねるなど、絶対に越えてはならない一線。

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: 사람들이 절대로 하지 않는다고 여기는 행위나 주제를 가리킨다. 예를 들어 다른 사람의 급여를 묻는 것은 금기로 여겨진다.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: 문화적으로 넘어서는 일이 금기로 여겨지는 선이다.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: Tema ou comportamento considerado proibido ou fortemente desmotivado em um grupo. Seu descumprimento costuma provocar constrangimento ou aprovação negativa.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: Limite que não se deve ultrapassar, como perguntar sobre o salário de alguém.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: Taboo merupakan batas yang dianggap tidak boleh dilanggar dalam kelompok tertentu, seperti menanyakan gaji seseorang. Topik terlarang dapat berbeda menurut budaya dan keadaan.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: Taboo adalah topik atau perilaku yang dianggap terlalu terlarang untuk dibahas.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: เช่น การถามเรื่องเงินเดือนของผู้อื่น ข้อห้ามอาจเปลี่ยนแปลงตามวัฒนธรรมและบริบท
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: เรื่องที่ไม่ควรพูดหรือทำเพราะถือเป็นข้อห้ามทางสังคม

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.definition: Toplumda uyulması gereken, üzerinde konuşulmaması gereken ve aşılması hoş görülmeyen sınır veya davranış.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.gloss: Maaşını sormak gibi hiç aşılmaması gereken sınır.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.text: Asking about his pay was a taboo, so I did not ask.
eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.translation: Maaşını sormak tabuydu, bu yüzden sormadım.

eb687fbf7c1801651f6a12ab30eece5f113086b2.text: Asking about his pay was a taboo, so I did not ask.
